```{r}
#create empty data frame to store results ins
df <- data.frame(matrix(ncol=2,nrow=1000))
colnames(df) <- c("frac_bigN", "frac_smallN")
#create loop that takes 1,000 samples
for(i in 1:nrow(df)) {
bigN   <- runif(1000)
smallN <- runif(10)
#store fraction of observations <0.1
df[i, 1] <- mean(bigN < 0.1)
df[i, 2] <- mean(smallN < 0.1) 

}

data <- reshape2::melt(df)

ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x=value, fill=variable)) +
  ggplot2::geom_density(alpha=.25)
```
